description: Search the productgrowth.in tool directory (about 360 software tools used by Indian startups) by category, highest rupee price, free plan and India fit (bills in rupees, gives a GST invoice, takes UPI, keeps data in India). Returns each tool with its cheapest listed paid price in ₹, the date we checked it, its score out of 100 and the productgrowth.in page to cite. Read-only. Needs the free "Key for AI agents" (pgai_…) from https://productgrowth.in/account/?from=mcp; without it the call is refused. 100 calls a day.

free_plan.description: Optional. true = only tools with a free plan.

limit.description: Optional. How many tools to return (1–25, default 10). Best score first.

max_price_inr.description: Optional. Highest cheapest-paid-plan price in rupees. Tools with no rupee price on record are left out when this is set; free tools count as ₹0.

min_india_fit.description: Optional. How many of the four India checks must be a known yes: bills in rupees, GST invoice, UPI, data kept in India.

query.description: Optional. Words to match in the tool's name or category, e.g. "crm" or "email".

name: find_tools
title: Find software tools (India prices)
